# EspdCommon

This library was generated with [Angular CLI](https://github.com/angular/angular-cli) version 11.1.2.

## Code scaffolding

Run `ng generate component component-name --project espd-common` to generate a new component. You can also use `ng generate directive|pipe|service|class|guard|interface|enum|module --project espd-common`.
> Note: Don't forget to add `--project espd-common` or else it will be added to the default project in your `angular.json` file. 

## Build

Run `ng build espd-common` to build the project. The build artifacts will be stored in the `dist/` directory.

## Publishing

After building your library with `ng build espd-common`, go to the dist folder `cd dist/espd-common` and run `npm publish`.

## Running unit tests

Run `ng test espd-common` to execute the unit tests via [Karma](https://karma-runner.github.io).

## Running in Docker

Run `docker-compose up -d --build`.
